غِشٌّ Dishonest, or insincere, conduct, or advice or counsel: (Msb, K:) and the embellishment of an affair [with false colours]: (Msb:) or dissimulation; pretence of the contrary of what one conceives in his mind. (K.) [See also 1.] ―
-b2- And Rancour, malevolence, malice, or (??) (K.) ―
-b3- [Also Adulterating alloy in coin (See حُمْلَانٌ.) ―
-b4- And Adulterated, or counterfeit, coin. (See زَغَلٌ.)]
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
